is_treaty_port_disable_pm_market_liquidity = {
	every_scope_state = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_treaty_port = yes
			}
			remove_modifier = offshore_port
			add_modifier = offshore_port
		}
	}
}

global_monetary_reference_2 = {
	set_global_variable = {
		name = global_monetary_reference_money_value
		value = {
			value = 0
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					has_modifier = global_monetary_reference
				}
				add = money_value
			}
		}
	}
}

	fluctuations_money_value_1_year = {
		change_variable = {
			name = money_value_fixe_var_1_1Y
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				var:money_value_fixe_var_1_1Y = 1
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_var_half_1_year
				value = money_value_rapported_inflation
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:money_value_fixe_var_1_1Y = 2
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_var_1_year
				value = money_value_rapported_inflation
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_dif_1
				value = 0
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = money_value_dif_1
				add = var:money_value_var_1_year
			}
			change_variable = { #test
				name = money_value_dif_1
				subtract = var:money_value_var_half_1_year
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = money_value_dif_1
				divide = var:money_value_var_half_1_year
			}

			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_fixe_var_1_1Y
				value = 0
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					money_value_dif_1_final < -0.5
					not = {
						#protection de la devise lorsque le joeur ou y a change de standart monetaire de silver vers au-dessus, en effet la money value peut baisser alors que la parité à l'or reste la meme
						#2 manière d'avoir ce modificateur:
						#- soit changer le standart
						#- soit changer la valeur du standart -> n peut pas modifier aussi rapidement la valeur et donc ne déclancherai quoi qu'il en soit pas de crise
						has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
					}
				}
				#plus de protection comme pour central_bank_bankruptcy & country_bankruptcy
				currency_crisis = yes
			}
		}
	}

		if = {

			}
		}

				has_modifier = devaluation_currency_25

			}

				name = monetary_policy_inflation
				add = 0.25
			}
		}

	monetary_policy_inflation_reset = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:monetary_policy_inflation < -1
				var:devaluation_on = 0
				var:revaluation_on = 0
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = monetary_policy_inflation
				add = 1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:monetary_policy_inflation > 1
				var:devaluation_on = 0
				var:revaluation_on = 0
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = monetary_policy_inflation
				subtract = 1
			}
		}
	}

		}

			limit = {
				inflation_value < -0.02
			}
			add_modifier = {
				name = deflation_country
				multiplier = inflation_value_for_modifier
			}
		}

	fluctuations_silver_to_gold_rate_1_year = {
		change_variable = {
			name = silver_to_gold_rate_fixe_var_1_1Y
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:silver_to_gold_rate_fixe_var_1_1Y = 1
			}
			set_global_variable = {
				name = silver_to_gold_rate_var_half_1_year
				value = silver_to_gold_rate
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:silver_to_gold_rate_fixe_var_1_1Y = 2
			}
			set_global_variable = {
				name = silver_to_gold_rate_var_1_year
				value = silver_to_gold_rate
			}
			set_global_variable = {
				name = silver_to_gold_rate_dif_1
				value = 0
			}
			change_global_variable = {
				name = silver_to_gold_rate_dif_1
				add = global_var:silver_to_gold_rate_var_1_year
			}
			change_global_variable = {
				name = silver_to_gold_rate_dif_1
				subtract = global_var:silver_to_gold_rate_var_half_1_year
			}
			change_global_variable = {
				name = silver_to_gold_rate_dif_1
				divide = global_var:silver_to_gold_rate_var_half_1_year
			}

			set_variable = {
				name = silver_to_gold_rate_fixe_var_1_1Y
				value = 0
			}
		}
	}

	money_value_target_modification = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				not = {
					or = {
						has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
						has_modifier = monetary_systeme_transition
					}
					AND = {
						#bloquer la revaluation des silver standart à partir de 1873 pour eviter des chose abrante sur le money value target
						game_date >= 1873.1.1
						has_law = law_type:law_silver_standard
					}
					#pour le bimetalisme ce callera sur l'or meme si les reserve sont majoritairement silver
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					devaluation_money_value_target_trigger = yes
					not = {
						or = {
							is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
							market_owner_is_root_univ_with_buiding = yes
						}
					}
				}
				devaluation_money_value_target = yes

				#event player
				capital= {
					save_scope_as = capital_state
				}
				save_scope_as = target_country

				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_player = yes
						scope:target_country = {
							scripted_money_value_target = no #test empeche UK et Mex d'avoir une notification pour indiquer une modification de parité inverse
						}
 					}
					trigger_event = 00_ef_economic_event.31
				}

				remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_target
				add_modifier = {
					name = devaluation_currency_target
					months = 12
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					revaluation_money_value_target_trigger = yes
					not = {
						or = {
							is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
							market_owner_is_root_univ_with_buiding = yes
						}
					}
				}
				revaluation_money_value_target = yes

				#event player
				capital= {
					save_scope_as = capital_state
				}
				save_scope_as = target_country

				every_country = {
					limit = {
						is_player = yes
						scope:target_country = {
							scripted_money_value_target = no #test empeche UK et Mex d'avoir une notification pour indiquer une modification de parité inverse
						}
					}
					trigger_event = 00_ef_economic_event.32
				}

				remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_target
				add_modifier = {
					name = revaluation_currency_target
					months = 12
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					or = {
						is_subject_custom_trigger = yes
						market_owner_is_root_univ_with_buiding = yes
					}
				}
				subject_money_value_target = yes
			}
		}
	}
	devaluation_money_value_target = {
		#Scripted
		if = {
			limit = {
				scripted_money_value_target = yes
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1_old
				value = devaluation_money_value_target
			}
			devaluation_revaluation_money_value_target_scripted_silver_bimetallism = yes
			devaluation_revaluation_money_value_target_scripted_gold = yes
			change_variable = {
				name = test_var_2
				add = 1
			}
		}

		#Generic
		if = {
			limit = {
				not = {
					scripted_money_value_target = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1_old
				value = var:money_value_target_1
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1
				value = devaluation_money_value_target
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = test_var_2
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
	revaluation_money_value_target = {
		#Scripted
		if = {
			limit = {
				scripted_money_value_target = yes
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1_old
				value = var:money_value_target_1
			}
			devaluation_revaluation_money_value_target_scripted_silver_bimetallism = yes
			devaluation_revaluation_money_value_target_scripted_gold = yes
			change_variable = {
				name = test_var_2
				add = 1
			}
		}

		#Generic
		if = {
			limit = {
				not = {
					scripted_money_value_target = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1_old
				value = var:money_value_target_1
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1
				value = revaluation_money_value_target
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = test_var_2
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}
	subject_money_value_target = {
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1
			value = overlord_money_value_target
		}
	}

	monetary_systeme_transition = {
		#Silver -> Bimetalisme
		if = {
			limit = {
				not = {
					has_modifier = monetary_systeme_transition
				}
				is_monetary_systeme_transition_valid_country_to_bimetalisme = yes
				is_monetary_systeme_transition_valid_country_to_gold_exchange_standard = no
			}
			#money_value_target_pre_set = yes
			activate_law = law_type:law_bimetallism_standard
			# central_bank_production_methods = yes
			# remove_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
			# add_modifier = {
			# 	name = foreign_exchange_controls
			# 	months = 12
			# }
			# reset_debt_in_currency_for_monetary_systeme_transition = yes

			# }

			# add_modifier = {
			# 	name = monetary_systeme_transition
			# 	months = 120
			# }
		}

		#Silver -> gold/Bimealisme -> Gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				not = {
					has_modifier = monetary_systeme_transition
				}
				is_monetary_systeme_transition_valid_country_to_gold = yes
				is_monetary_systeme_transition_valid_country_to_gold_exchange_standard = no
			}
			#money_value_target_pre_set = yes

			# add_modifier = {

	extreme_weak_currency_solution_player = {
		change_variable = {
			name = extreme_weak_currency_solution_count_player
			add = 1
		}
	}

	extreme_weak_currency_solution = {
		change_variable = {
			name = extreme_weak_currency_solution_count
			add = 1
		}
		#reset currency
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:extreme_weak_currency_solution_count >= 3 #3 #passe les 2ans des modificateur puis 1 ans après recrer une currency/protege aussi les pays revolutionnaire qui on perdu leur capital sans dé"calncher de centralbank bankrupcy
				not = {
					or = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_bankruptcy_country
						has_modifier = currency_crisis_country
					}
				}
			}

 			reset_balance = yes
			reset_debt_currency_reserve_and_export_value = yes
			reset_law_event_currency  = yes

			set_variable = new_currency_recreat

			law_no_monetary_system_with_tech_currency_standards = yes

			introduction_new_currency = yes

			set_variable = {
				name = extreme_weak_currency_solution_count
				value = 0
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = new_currency_count
				add = 1
			}
			money_value_global_var = yes
 			reset_balance = yes #recalcule de la balance fianl
		}
	}

	devaluation_on = {
		change_variable = {
			name = devaluation_on_time
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				var:devaluation_on_time = devaluation_time_month
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = devaluation_on
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1
				value = var:money_value_target_valided
			}

			############# Reset
			set_variable = {
				name = devaluation_on_time
				value = 0
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_no_monetary_policy #test
			monetary_policy_ideology_dynamic_reset = yes
		}
	}
	revaluation_on = {
		change_variable = {
			name = revaluation_on_time
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				var:revaluation_on_time = revaluation_time_month
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = revaluation_on
				value = 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = money_value_target_1
				value = var:money_value_target_valided
			}

			############# Reset
			set_variable = {
				name = revaluation_on_time
				value = 0
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_no_monetary_policy #test
			monetary_policy_ideology_dynamic_reset = yes
		}
	}

	monetary_policy_ideology_dynamic = {
	capital = {
		save_scope_as = capital_state
	}
	save_scope_as = target_country

	random_interest_group = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_monetary_policy }
		}
		save_scope_as = ig_want_a_large_monetary_policy
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:ig_want_a_large_monetary_policy
			OR = {
				central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent > 1.25
				central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent < 0.75
				zz_ef_rate_policy_steps >= 2
			}
		}
		trigger_event = 00_ef_economic_event.106
	}

	random_interest_group = {
		limit = {
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_monetary_policy
		}
		save_scope_as = ig_no_want_a_large_monetary_policy
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:ig_no_want_a_large_monetary_policy
			central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent < 1.25
			central_bank_metal_reserves_state_to_ensure_the_conversion_pourcent > 0.75
			zz_ef_rate_policy_steps < 2
		}
		trigger_event = 00_ef_economic_event.107
	}
}
	monetary_policy_ideology_dynamic_reset = {
		every_interest_group = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_monetary_policy
			}
			remove_ideology = ideology_monetary_policy
		}
	}

money_value_target_pre_set = {
	# Si standard argent
	if = {
		limit = {
			#has_law = law_type:law_silver_standard
			var:law_silver_standard ?= 1
		}
		#bimetalique
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1_bimetallic
			value = money_value_bimetallism_standard
		}
		#gold
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1_gold
			value = money_value_gold_standard
		}
	}
	# Si standard bimétallique
	if = {
		limit = {
			#has_law = law_type:law_bimetallism_standard
			var:law_bimetallism_standard ?= 1
		}
		#silver
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1_silver
			value = money_value_silver_standard
		}
		#gold
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1_gold
			value = money_value_gold_standard
		}
	}
	# Si standard or
	if = {
		limit = {
			#has_law = law_type:law_gold_standard
			var:law_gold_standard ?= 1
		}
		#silver
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1_silver
			value = money_value_silver_standard
		}
		#bimetalique
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1_bimetallic
			value = money_value_bimetallism_standard
		}
	}
}

set_reset_monetary_system_status = {

	set_variable = {
		name = law_no_monetary_system
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = law_fiat_standard
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = law_silver_standard
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = law_bimetallism_standard
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = law_gold_standard
		value = 0
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = law_gold_exchange_standard
		value = 0
	}

	###########################################################################################################################################################################################
	###########################################################################################################################################################################################
	###########################################################################################################################################################################################
	###########################################################################################################################################################################################

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = law_type:law_no_monetary_system
			has_law = law_type:law_bimetallic_ratio_no
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = law_no_monetary_system
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = law_type:law_fiat_standard
			has_law = law_type:law_bimetallic_ratio_no
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = law_fiat_standard
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = law_type:law_silver_standard
			has_law = law_type:law_bimetallic_ratio_no
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = law_silver_standard
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = law_type:law_bimetallism_standard
			has_law = law_type:law_bimetallic_ratio_15
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = law_bimetallism_standard
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = law_type:law_gold_standard
			has_law = law_type:law_bimetallic_ratio_no
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = law_gold_standard
			value = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = law_type:law_gold_exchange_standard
			has_law = law_type:law_bimetallic_ratio_no
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = law_gold_exchange_standard
			value = 1
		}
	}
}
on_activate_monetary_system_law = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = extreme_weak_currency_solution_count }
				var:extreme_weak_currency_solution_count = 0
			}
		}
		zz_ef_std_switch_before = yes
		money_value_target_pre_set = yes
		central_bank_production_methods = yes
		remove_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		add_modifier = {
			name = foreign_exchange_controls
			months = 12
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = money_value_target_1
			value = money_value_target_pre_set
		}
		zz_ef_std_switch_after = yes
		trade_balance = yes
		remove_modifier = monetary_systeme_transition
		add_modifier = {
			name = monetary_systeme_transition
			months = 12
		}
		set_reset_monetary_system_status = yes
	}
}

on_activate_law_no_monetary_policy = {
	zz_ef_mp_clear = yes
}

on_activate_law_revaluation = {
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_25
	remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_25
	add_modifier = {
		name = revaluation_currency_25
	}
	zz_ef_mp_init = yes
}
on_activate_law_devaluation = {
	remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_25
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_25
	add_modifier = {
		name = devaluation_currency_25
	}
	zz_ef_mp_init = yes
}

	if  = { limit = { 	money_value_thaler_prussian_thaler > 0  } stockpiling_currency_type_1 = { currency = thaler_prussian_thaler }  }
	if  = { limit = { 	money_value_thaler_saxon_thaler > 0  } stockpiling_currency_type_1 = { currency = thaler_saxon_thaler }  }
}
stockpiling_currency_type_1 = {
	#il ne faut pas que des sujet no market owner puisse déclanché car le $currency$_c_market_goods_delta et donc le stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2 sont positif quelque soit le market owner si il y a le  bien dans le marché

	#######################################################################
	#scope
	every_scope_state = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site
		}
	}

	#cela est pour récupérer la valeur de l'etat
	set_variable = {
		name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1
		value = stockpiling_$currency$_state #récupèrer stockpiling_$currency$_state_1 soit la valeur de l'état
	}
	change_variable = {
		name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1
		subtract = var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_in_reserve_currency #si un nouveau pays ce crer alors cette valeur sera de 2 est la totalité des reserve de l'etat sera equivalenbte à l'ancienne valeur dans l'etat et la valeur issiu de la reserve
	}
	set_variable = {
		name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
		value = 0
	}

	#######################################################################
	#modification de la valeur dans la reserve de la bank centrale soit par politique soit par mainting simple

	#For country witch $currency$ law
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_law = law_type:law_$currency$_currency
		}

		#stockpiling in central bank currency reserve
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1 > 0
				or = {
					not = {
						$currency$_c_market_goods_delta = 0
					}
					var:devaluation_on = 1
					var:revaluation_on = 1
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
				add = $currency$_c_market_goods_delta
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
				multiply = 4
			}

			#politique monétaire devaluation
			if = { limit = { var:devaluation_on = 1 } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2 add = money_supply_to_add_per_month } }
			#politique monétaire réévaluation
			if = { limit = { var:revaluation_on = 1 } change_variable = { name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2 add = money_supply_to_subtract_per_month } }

			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1
				add = var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
			}
		}

		#circulating_$currency$_c_1 #les pop
		set_variable = {
			name = circulating_$currency$_c_var_2
			value = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				$currency$_c_market_goods_buy_orders > 0
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = circulating_$currency$_c_var_2
				add = $currency$_c_market_goods_buy_orders
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = circulating_$currency$_c_var_2
				multiply = 4
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = circulating_$currency$_c_var_1
				add = var:circulating_$currency$_c_var_2
			}
		}
		#reset de la valeur de la reserve de la bc si négative
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1 < 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1
				value = 0
			}
		}
		#stockpiling_$currency$_c_state_1 -> remettre la valeur dans l'état
		if = {
			limit = {
				market_owner_is_root = yes
				var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1 >= 0
 			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				if = {
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_$currency$_state_1
						value = root.var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	#######################################################################

	#######################################################################
	#Trade balance sockpile and Stockpiling if $currency$ in market
	if = {
		limit = {
			market_owner_is_root = yes
			not = {
				has_law = law_type:law_$currency$_currency
			}
		}

		# #Stockpiling if $currency$ in market but no my currency -> plus de reserve de d'autre currency dans le marcher
		# if = {
		# 	limit = {
		# 		$currency$_c_market_goods_delta > 0
		# 	}
		# 	change_variable = {
		# 		name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
		# 		add = $currency$_c_market_goods_delta
		# 	}
		# 	change_variable = {
		# 		name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
		# 		multiply = 4
		# 	}
		# 	change_variable = {
		# 		name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1
		# 		add = var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
		# 	}
		# 	scope:central_bank_site = {
		# 		if = {
		# 			set_variable = {
		# 				name = stockpiling_$currency$_state_1
		# 				value = root.var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_1
		# 			}
		# 		}
		# 	}
		# }

		#reserve_currency_$currency$
		if = {
			limit = {
				or  = {
					#export_in_$currency$ > 0
					export_to_$currency$ > 0 #revient au meme et beaucoup moinn de chiffre à géré et à calculé
					not  = {
						scope:central_bank_site.var:stockpiling_$currency$_reserve_currency_state_1 = owner.var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_in_reserve_currency
					}
				}
			}
			#quantité de devise stocké par la balanace du commerce
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_in_reserve_currency
				add = export_in_$currency$
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				if = {
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_$currency$_reserve_currency_state_1
						value = root.var:stockpiling_$currency$_c_in_reserve_currency
					}
				}
			}

			#ajout au gui du flux de l'accumulation
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_$currency$_c_var_2
				add  = {
					add = export_in_$currency$
					divide = 4
				}
			}
		}
	}
	#debt_in_$currency$
	if = {
		limit = {
			import_in_$currency$ > 0
			import_export_disable = 0 #désactive l'accumulation de dette si le pays entre en crise
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = debt_in_national_currency_$currency$
			add = import_in_$currency$
		}
	}
	#######################################################################

	#all_$currency$_stored -> stock la valeur du stockpile + la valeur du commerce
	scope:central_bank_site = {
		set_variable = {
			name = all_$currency$_stored
			value = owner.stockpiling_$currency$_state  #var:stockpiling_$currency$_state_1
		}
	}
}

#brace
    #dinar
	buy_dinar_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = dinar_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:dinar_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}
	}
	sell_dinar_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = dinar_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_dinar_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:dinar_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}

							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency

						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_dinar_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}

	sell_dinar_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_dinar_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #dinar_algerian_dinar
	buy_dinar_algerian_dinar_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_algerian_dinar_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_algerian_dinar_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_dinar_algerian_dinar_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = dinar_algerian_dinar_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:dinar_algerian_dinar_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_algerian_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_algerian_dinar_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}
	}

	buy_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = dinar_iraqi_dinar_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:dinar_iraqi_dinar_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var

	sell_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = dinar_iraqi_dinar_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:dinar_iraqi_dinar_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit

						}
					}

							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}

	sell_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_libyan_dinar_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_libyan_dinar_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = dinar_libyan_dinar_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:dinar_libyan_dinar_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_dinar_libyan_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_dinar_libyan_dinar_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency

				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {

							law_dinar_libyan_dinar_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes

	sell_dinar_libyan_dinar_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_libyan_dinar_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #dinar_moroccan_dirham
	buy_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = dinar_moroccan_dirham_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:dinar_moroccan_dirham_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}

						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}

	sell_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #dinar_omanian_rial
	buy_dinar_omanian_rial_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = dinar_omanian_rial_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = dinar_omanian_rial_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:dinar_omanian_rial_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_omanian_rial_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_omanian_rial_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}

			variable = dinar_qiran_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_dinar_qiran_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_dinar_qiran_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = dinar_qiran_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:dinar_qiran_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_dinar_qiran_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {

							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}

							#metal

								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
