	sell_franc_luxembourgish_franc_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = franc_luxembourgish_franc_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = franc_luxembourgish_franc_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:franc_luxembourgish_franc_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency

						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var

	sell_franc_luxembourgish_franc_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:franc_swiss_franc_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_franc_swiss_franc_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_franc_swiss_franc_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency

					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {

								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}

	sell_franc_swiss_franc_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	buy_gulden_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = gulden_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gulden_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_gulden_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = gulden_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:gulden_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}

							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	sell_gulden_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_gulden_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_gulden_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #gulden_bavarian_gulden
	buy_gulden_bavarian_gulden_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = gulden_bavarian_gulden_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = gulden_bavarian_gulden_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:gulden_bavarian_gulden_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}

	sell_gulden_bavarian_gulden_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = gulden_bavarian_gulden_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = gulden_bavarian_gulden_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:gulden_bavarian_gulden_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}

						}

							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var

						value = {

	sell_gulden_florin_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = gulden_florin_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gulden_florin_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = gulden_florin_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:gulden_florin_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_gulden_florin_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_gulden_florin_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency

							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message

					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_florin_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_florin_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}

	sell_gulden_florin_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_gulden_florin_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	sell_gulden_hungarian_forint_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_gulden_hungarian_forint_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #gulden_indies_guilder
	buy_gulden_indies_guilder_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = gulden_indies_guilder_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = gulden_indies_guilder_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:gulden_indies_guilder_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_indies_guilder_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_indies_guilder_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}

							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {

							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {

					}

								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_indies_guilder_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	sell_gulden_indies_guilder_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #gulden_south_german_gulden
	buy_gulden_south_german_gulden_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = gulden_south_german_gulden_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gulden_south_german_gulden_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_gulden_south_german_gulden_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = gulden_south_german_gulden_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:gulden_south_german_gulden_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_south_german_gulden_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_gulden_south_german_gulden_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {

							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}

	sell_gulden_south_german_gulden_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes

					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}

		if = {
			limit = {

				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_gulden_south_german_gulden_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = gulden_south_german_gulden_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:gulden_south_german_gulden_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_gulden_south_german_gulden_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				if = {

						}

							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:krone_czech_koruna_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_krone_czech_koruna_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_krone_czech_koruna_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile

							#metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}

	sell_krone_czech_koruna_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = krone_czech_koruna_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = krone_czech_koruna_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:krone_czech_koruna_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var

					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_krone_czech_koruna_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {

	sell_krone_czech_koruna_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	sell_krone_danish_krone_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_krone_danish_krone_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	buy_krone_estonian_kroon_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {

				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha

						value = var:krone_estonian_kroon_quantity_var
					}

						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							value = 1

							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_estonian_kroon_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_krone_estonian_kroon_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}

							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {

							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile

						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_krone_estonian_kroon_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_estonian_kroon_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_krone_estonian_kroon_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_estonian_kroon_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}
