	sell_peso_philippine_peso_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	sell_peso_sol_de_oro_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = peso_sol_de_oro_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_peso_sol_de_oro_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = peso_sol_de_oro_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:peso_sol_de_oro_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_peso_sol_de_oro_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_peso_sol_de_oro_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_reserve_currency_state_1

							law_peso_sol_de_oro_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes

						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {

	sell_peso_sol_de_oro_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_sol_de_oro_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_sol_de_oro_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	buy_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = peso_uruguayan_peso_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = peso_uruguayan_peso_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:peso_uruguayan_peso_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_peso_uruguayan_peso_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_peso_uruguayan_peso_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {

						name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_peso_uruguayan_peso_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_peso_uruguayan_peso_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}

	sell_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #peso_venezuelan_peso
	buy_peso_venezuelan_peso_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = peso_venezuelan_peso_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_peso_venezuelan_peso_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_peso_venezuelan_peso_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = peso_venezuelan_peso_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:peso_venezuelan_peso_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_peso_venezuelan_peso_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_peso_venezuelan_peso_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}
	}

	buy_pound_egyptian_pound_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {

				}
			}
		}

			variable = pound_egyptian_pound_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_pound_egyptian_pound_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_pound_egyptian_pound_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = pound_egyptian_pound_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:pound_egyptian_pound_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_pound_egyptian_pound_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}

							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver

							law_pound_egyptian_pound_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal

									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

	sell_pound_egyptian_pound_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_pound_egyptian_pound_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	sell_pound_irish_pound_currency = {

		#mecha

				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {

					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_pound_irish_pound_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit

						}
					}

						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency

						name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}

							name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0

							}
						}

							set_variable = {

	sell_pound_irish_pound_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_pound_irish_pound_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	buy_pound_sterling_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = pound_sterling_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_pound_sterling_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_pound_sterling_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = pound_sterling_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:pound_sterling_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_pound_sterling_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_pound_sterling_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_pound_sterling_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_pound_sterling_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1

								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_pound_sterling_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_pound_sterling_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_pound_sterling_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_pound_sterling_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_pound_sterling_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_pound_sterling_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}

	sell_pound_sterling_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_pound_sterling_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_pound_sterling_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_pound_sterling_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_pound_sterling_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #real
	buy_real_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = real_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_real_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_real_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = real_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:real_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_real_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_real_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_real_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_real_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_real_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_real_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}
	}

							}
						}
					}

							var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency < 0

	sell_real_brazilian_real_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = real_brazilian_real_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_real_brazilian_real_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = real_brazilian_real_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:real_brazilian_real_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_real_brazilian_real_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_real_brazilian_real_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit

	sell_real_brazilian_real_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_real_brazilian_real_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	sell_rupee_indian_rupee_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indian_rupee_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

	buy_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = rupee_indonesian_rupiah_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:rupee_indonesian_rupiah_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}

							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner = {
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
								add = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}


					}
					reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	sell_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #spe_baht
	buy_spe_baht_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = spe_baht_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = spe_baht_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:spe_baht_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_spe_baht_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_spe_baht_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_spe_baht_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_spe_baht_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

				}
			}
		}
	}
	sell_spe_baht_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = spe_baht_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
				}
			}
		}

		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
				scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
					sell_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:seller_root = {
				set_variable = {
					name = spe_baht_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_spe_baht_state
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					value = var:spe_baht_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
					}
				}

				#gold
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_spe_baht_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					#notification
					every_country = {
						limit  = {
							is_player = yes
						}
						save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
						}
						scope:is_player_for_notification = {
							post_notification = your_currency_are_sell_message
						}
					}
				}

				#silver
				if = {
					limit = {
						law_spe_baht_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
						scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = { #verifit si la reserve d'or du pays avec la devise sur évalué est superieur à ce qu'elle doit
							scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal
						change_variable = {
							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}

					}

						set_variable = {

							value = 0

					if = { #actualise la variable

							}

								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}

						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal

	sell_spe_dong_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = seller_root
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}

				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = spe_dong_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place

		#mecha

				}
			}

				set_variable = {
					name = spe_dong_quantity_var
					value = stockpiling_spe_dong_state
				}

					value = var:spe_dong_quantity_var
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = 0.5
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
					value = {
						value = 1
						add = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
						multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value

				}

				#gold

					limit = {
						law_spe_dong_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes

						}
					}
					scope:central_bank_site_root = {
						#metal

							name = gold_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1
								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_root.var:stockpiling_spe_dong_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_dong_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}

						limit  = {
							is_player = yes

	sell_spe_dong_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_spe_dong_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_spe_dong_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_dong_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_spe_dong_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_spe_dong_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
