							name = silver_state_1
							add = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_currency_state_1_buy_in_metal
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					}

						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_root = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}

								subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
							}

	sell_thaler_prussian_thaler_currency_crisis = {
	scope:seller = {
		save_scope_as = seller_root
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_root
		}
	}
	scope:target_country = {
		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_thaler_prussian_thaler_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}
    #thaler_saxon_thaler
	buy_thaler_saxon_thaler_currency = {

		#scope:
		root = {
			save_scope_as = buyer
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}
		random_in_global_list = {
			variable = thaler_saxon_thaler_currency_law_list_ordered_1 #overrated_currency_list
			save_scope_as = undervalued_currency_country_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_seller
				}
			}
		}

		#reset_purchase_cycle
		set_variable = {
			name = purchase_cycle
			value = 0
		}
		#mecha
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner
				scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = {
					has_law = law_type:law_thaler_saxon_thaler_currency
					buy_currency_1 = yes
				}
			}

			scope:buyer = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						not  = {
							has_law = law_type:law_thaler_saxon_thaler_currency
						}
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = thaler_saxon_thaler_quantity_var
						value = { value = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.zz_ef_fx_deal_size if = { limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_cover_normal } } value = 0 } }
					}
					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						value = var:thaler_saxon_thaler_quantity_var
					}

					set_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
						value = {
							value = 1
							add = var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							multiply = scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real #money_value
						}
					}

					#gold
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_thaler_saxon_thaler_monetary_system_GS_GES_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < gold_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = gold_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = gold_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal

								}
								change_variable = {
									name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
									add = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
								}
							}
						}
						#notification
						every_country = {
							limit  = {
								is_player = yes
							}
							save_scope_as = is_player_for_notification
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner = scope:is_player_for_notification
							}
							scope:is_player_for_notification = {
								post_notification = your_currency_are_buy_message
							}
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = purchase_cycle
							value = 1
						}
					}

					#silver
					if = {
						limit = {
							law_thaler_saxon_thaler_monetary_system_SS_BS_trigger = yes
							var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal < silver_state_native_for_stockpile
							scope:undervalued_currency_country_owner.stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state > var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_seller = {
							#metal
							change_variable = {
								name = silver_state_1
								add = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
							}
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
								subtract = scope:buyer.var:stockpiling_undervalued_quantity_var
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site = {
							scope:central_bank_site = {
								#metal
								change_variable = {
									name = silver_state_1
									subtract = owner.var:stockpiling_undervalued_currency_state_1_buyer_in_metal
								}
								change_variable = {

		save_scope_as = overrated_currency_country_owner
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_root
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_overrated_currency_owner
			scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
				has_law = law_type:law_thaler_saxon_thaler_currency
				sell_currency_crisis_1 = yes
			}
		}
		scope:seller_root = {
			# all of it, at the parity, as far as the issuer's metal goes
			set_variable = { name = stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var value = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state }
			set_variable = {
				name = zz_ef_crisis_due
				value = {
					value = var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
					multiply = scope:overrated_currency_country_owner.money_value_target_real
					min = 0
				}
			}
			zz_ef_crisis_redeem = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
					var:stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency > 0
				}
				set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency value = 0 }
			}
			scope:central_bank_site_root = {
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1 value = 0 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1 } set_variable = { name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1 value = 0 } }
			}
		}
		scope:overrated_currency_country_owner = {
			reset_debt_in_national_currency = yes
		}
	}
}

reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = {
	#dinar
	if  = {
		limit  = {
			scope:player_country = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			var:debt_in_national_currency_dinar > 0
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = debt_in_national_currency_dinar
			subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:debt_in_national_currency_dinar < 0
			}
			set_variable = {
				name = debt_in_national_currency_dinar

			}

stockpiling_capital_state_transfert = {
	financial_center_modifier = yes

	every_scope_state = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_capital
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
				is_capital = no
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_no_capital
		}
	}

	if  = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:central_bank_site_no_capital

stockpiling_capital_state_transfert_financial_center_place = {
	every_scope_state = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:financial_center_site_var =  1
			}
			save_scope_as = financial_center_site_capital #non nécessairement la capital
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:financial_center_site_var = 0
				not = {
					var:looted_state = 1
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = financial_center_site_no_capital #non nécessairement la capital
		}
	}
	if  = {
		limit  = {
			exists = scope:financial_center_site_no_capital
			#exists = scope:financial_center_site_capital
		}

		#actual Capital
		scope:financial_center_site_capital = {

			change_variable = {
				name = test_var_1
				add = 1
			}

			#####################
			#financial product
			#####################

			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_bond_var_state_1
				add = {
					scope:financial_center_site_no_capital = {
						add = var:stockpiling_bond_var_state_1
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_manufacture_stock_var_state_1
				add = {
					scope:financial_center_site_no_capital = {
						add = var:stockpiling_manufacture_stock_var_state_1
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_agricultural_stock_var_state_1
				add = {
					scope:financial_center_site_no_capital = {
						add = var:stockpiling_agricultural_stock_var_state_1
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_mining_stock_var_state_1
				add = {
					scope:financial_center_site_no_capital = {
						add = var:stockpiling_mining_stock_var_state_1
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = stockpiling_railroad_stock_var_state_1
				add = {
					scope:financial_center_site_no_capital = {
						add = var:stockpiling_railroad_stock_var_state_1
					}
				}
			}
		}

		#old capital
		scope:financial_center_site_no_capital = {
			if  = {
				limit  = {
					exists = scope:financial_center_site_no_capital
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = looted_state
					value = 1
				}

				change_variable = {
					name = test_var_1
					add = 1
				}

				#####################
				#financial product
				#####################

				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_bond_var_state_1
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_manufacture_stock_var_state_1
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_agricultural_stock_var_state_1
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_mining_stock_var_state_1
					value = 0
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_railroad_stock_var_state_1
					value = 0
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				is_capital = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = central_bank_site_capital
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_at_war = yes
			has_war_with = ROOT
		}
		capital = {
			if = {

# Ф.2 (the user, 4.10): that interest is now paid -- by the issuer's treasury, every January
# (zz_ef_privbank_interest_pay, the monthly step) -- so the holder gets it always, not only while
# its pool is under the target (EF.34: "money from nothing" in the banks' card).
investement_pool_borrowing = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			ai_privat_bank_total_interest > 0
		}
		add_investment_pool = ai_privat_bank_total_interest
	}
}

	if  = {
		limit  = {
			scope:seller_root = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
			var:debt_in_national_currency_dinar > 0
		}
		change_variable = {
			name = debt_in_national_currency_dinar
			subtract = scope:seller_root.var:stockpiling_overrated_quantity_var
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:debt_in_national_currency_dinar < 0
			}
			set_variable = {

# В3.2 (5.10, runs s1b / s1c): E&F's monthly pulse (ef_on_monthly_pulse_recurence) puts a subject with a CB inside its
# overlord's market on law_external_exchange_standard (subject_currency) every month it is not on it; the currency
# zone (zz_ef_currency_zone.txt) then put it back on the overlord's standard -- a standard switch every month for
# Hanover, the Canadas, Finland, the Dutch East Indies... (each with E&F's 12 months of foreign_exchange_controls).
# A subject in the zone (var:zz_ef_cur_zone) is skipped here; any other -- E&F's body as is.
# !! MAINTENANCE !! Key-level REPLACE_OR_CREATE of E&F's subject_currency (01_economic_scripted_effects.txt):
# E&F's body as of 04.07.2026 inside the else.
subject_currency = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_cur_zone } }
		activate_law = law_type:law_external_exchange_standard
		money_value_target_modification = yes
		capital = {
			save_scope_as = capital_state
		}
		save_scope_as = target_country
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
				game_date >= 1837.1.1
			}
			trigger_event = 00_ef_economic_event.28
		}
	}
}
